distinguishing_fact: Subheading 5205.12.10 requires the yarn to be unbleached and not mercerized, which was directly confirmed by CBP laboratory analysis; 5205.12.20 covers other yarns (e.g., bleached, dyed, or mercerized).
reasoning: The goods are 1-ply single yarns of 100% carded (uncombed) cotton, not put up for retail sale because the samples with support weigh more than 125 grams (Section XI Note 4). The laboratory test results established metric counts (Nm) of 20.1 and 27.03, falling squarely in the range 'Exceeding 14 nm but not exceeding 43 nm' under subheading 5205.12. Because laboratory analysis established the yarns are composed wholly of unbleached cotton and are not mercerized, the goods are properly classified under 5205.12.1000.

distinguishing_fact: The subject merchandise is a new, functional, rechargeable prismatic lithium-ion electric accumulator; heading 8549 sweep candidates cover electrical/electronic waste, scrap, and spent batteries.
reasoning: The item is a prismatic lithium-ion battery consisting of two rechargeable cells housed in an aluminum casing with terminals, used for electrical power storage and supply. Heading 8507 covers 'Electric storage batteries, including separators therefor, whether or not rectangular (including square); parts thereof', and Note 3 to Chapter 85 confirms that accumulators include ancillary components and housings. Heading 8549 candidates from the correlation table are sweep provisions for waste and scrap (defined in Chapter 85 Subheading Note 5 for spent batteries as those not capable of being recharged or used), which do not apply to functional new goods. Under heading 8507, the specific subheading for lithium-ion batteries is 8507.60.00.

citations.quote: For the purposes of heading 8507, the expression "electric accumulators" includes those presented with ancillary components which contribute to the accumulator's function of storing and supplying energy or protect it from damage, such as electrical connectors, temperature control devices (for example, thermistors) and circuit protection devices. They may also include a portion of the protective housing of the goods in which they are to be used.

For the purposes of subheadings 8549.11 to 8549.19, “spent primary cells, spent primary batteries and spent electric accumulators: are those which are neither usable as such because of breakage, cutting-up, wear or other reasons, nor capable of being recharged.
